new_region_selection_rule: Fixed geographic boxes selected by setting and availability, before reading velocity, coherence or population-weighted results. Retain null and reverse effects.
new_region_product_candidate: Sangha et al. 2026 ARIA-based InSAR-only relative LOS velocity and mean spatial coherence; Zenodo 19493073, v1. Verify exact per-track dates, sign, units, references, geometry and no GNSS fitted ramps in archived configurations.

new_region_analysis.support_definition: Joint finite published LOS rate and coherence meeting threshold; not a physical accuracy guarantee
new_region_analysis.estimand: Population-weighted area/pixel support deficit, conditional on published population allocation

independent_gnss.candidate: Full contemporaneous NGL daily time series in the archived track footprint, independently projected into documented LOS geometry; remove reference station from evaluation
independent_gnss.calibration_validation_rule: Reference/frame adjustment stations disjoint from validation stations. No validation rate or residual used to pick reference, thresholds or masks. Report all prespecified spatial/time-eligible stations and exclusions.
independent_gnss.uncertainty: Temporal dependence assessed by time-block sensitivity rather than iid formal CI. Coordinate-frame alignment cannot validate unobserved pixels.

quality_coverage_error.evaluation: Frozen 44 held-out interferogram edges. Post-filter fixed training inversion; no claims of independently sampled edges or external physical accuracy. Show domain coverage and evaluable coverage separately; no tuning thresholds on held-out residuals.

controlled_holes.units: Official 2020 TIGER Census block polygons, complete fixed Fresno ROI
required_reporting: no missing values recoded as zero

residential_reference: Independent municipal/county land-use classification, limited to residential eligibility; do not treat buildings or parcels as household/person counts. Record source lineage and mismatch with 2020 epoch.
